head: 588a965b8c96ce8fd127ce5fe98a2035997abe52
title: fix(wearables): iPhone clients can reach Apple Health; Connections offers only what this phone can connect (AUDIT-11-125)
body:
**Tier:** T4 (health data surface and App Store compliance; client-only, no backend, no data path change)
**Why:** On the iOS store build (eas.json `production`, no `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_CLIENT_TUTORIAL`) the only entry points to Apple Health (More > "Connected devices" and "Health and sleep") were behind the clinic tutorial flag, so they never render on iPhone. Separately, Connections listed 12 cloud services (Garmin, Fitbit, Oura, WHOOP, Strava, Polar, Wahoo, Withings, Peloton, MyFitnessPal, Eight Sleep, Beddit) plus the other platform's store, each with a Connect button that can only end in "isn't switched on yet" (backend `FEATURE_WEARABLES_CLOUD_CONNECTORS` is unset in `.github/fly-env-desired-state.json`; four of them have no backend connector at all).
**T4 trigger scan:** health data (which screens can start an Apple Health / Health Connect connect). Auth, money, RLS/tenancy, credentials, destructive data: none touched.
**T3 trigger scan:** store review (App Review 2.5.1 HealthKit UI, 2.1 completeness); navigation entry points.
**Bounded T1:** copy in code comments only.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-11-125 (agent 125, Claude Opus 5.5).
**Acceptance evidence:** `src/screens/client/__tests__/MoreScreen.reach.test.tsx` (new AUDIT-11-125 block: iPhone shows both rows after the plan rows and they open `Connections` / `Health`; Android without Health Connect shows none; Health Connect build shows both; clinic tutorial keeps them first) and `src/screens/client/wearables/__tests__/ConnectionsScreen.test.tsx` (iPhone offers Apple Health only; Android offers Health Connect + Samsung Health; an existing cloud connection stays listed to manage, a disconnected one does not). The iPhone rows test fails on main (rows absent). PR CI runs the full suite and tsc.

Works against the current production backend: no new route, no new call. Connections still reads `GET /v1/wearables/connections`; connect still uses `POST /v1/wearables/connections/on-device` + `/samples/ingest` (`FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST=true`). No new flag: the fix is on at launch.

Overlap: `src/screens/client/MoreScreen.tsx` is also touched by open m#402 (one line, Membership description, line ~102). This PR edits the wearables rows and the list assembly (lines ~204-258) only; no conflict expected.

### B fixed
- **B-AUD11-1 (App Store / core flow):** An iPhone client on the 10-07 store build opens More to connect Apple Health and there is no "Connected devices" or "Health and sleep" row anywhere, so Apple Health can never be connected, the coach's Health tab stays empty, and App Review sees a HealthKit-entitled binary with no HealthKit screen (Guideline 2.5.1 rejection). Owner device pass step E6 (iPhone: More, Connected devices, Apple Health) cannot be done on the production build. Fix: the two rows show on iPhone always and on Android in a Health Connect build (clinic), after the plan rows; with the clinic tutorial on they stay first, unchanged.
- **B-AUD11-2 (false claim / store completeness):** A client opens Connected devices, taps Connect on Garmin, Oura, WHOOP or any of the 12 listed cloud services and is told "Connecting Garmin isn't switched on yet. Your coach will let you know when it is ready", which is false (none of those integrations is on in this release and the coach is never told anything); on iPhone the list also offers Health Connect and Samsung Health, which only say they work on Android. Fix: Connections offers only what this phone can connect (Apple Health on iPhone; Health Connect and Samsung Health on Android); any provider the person already has a live connection for stays listed so it can still be reconnected or disconnected.

### U fixed
- **U-AUD11-1 (false copy):** A client with nothing connected opens Health and sleep and reads "Connect Apple Health, Garmin, Fitbit or any tracker", but only Apple Health (iPhone) or Health Connect (Android) can be connected. Now names the one store this phone connects.
- **U-AUD11-2 (dead buttons, coach):** A coach opens a client's Health tab: with no data the "Connect a tracker" button does nothing (the coach navigator has no `Connections` route), and with data the Heart, Workouts, Body and Steps cards look tappable but do nothing (no `WearableMetricDetail` route for coaches). The coach embed now shows "No health data from this client yet" with no button, and its cards are read-only (no chevron). Test: `src/screens/client/wearables/__tests__/HealthFitnessEmptyState.test.tsx`.
